metadata.description: Local VM administrator password. Do not use or store the tenant account password.
Object ID of the existing Entra security group named AVD Users. Create the group manually before deployment.
Existing VNet resource group, not the new VM resource group. Leave the default only when both are the same; otherwise enter the VNet resource group name.
Name of the existing virtual network.
Name of the existing subnet used for AVD session hosts.
Location for the AVD resources. It must match the existing VNet location.
Windows 11 multi-session image. M365 SKUs include Microsoft 365 Apps but do not grant an Apps license. The offer is selected automatically.
Workspace display name shown in Windows App.
Size of the session host VM.
OS disk storage account type supported by the selected VM size and region.
Maximum number of user sessions allowed on each session host.
Prefix for the Windows computer and Azure VM names. Appends -0 through -9; maximum prefix length is 13. Use a new prefix for subsequent host additions.
Approved PowerShell script URL. Default runs Japanese configuration; clear this field to skip custom configuration and keep the image language.
Number of session hosts to create (1-10). More VMs increase cost and require sufficient quota and subnet capacity.
New host pool type. Cannot be changed for an existing pool. Personal uses automatic assignment and Persistent balancing.
Pooled load balancing algorithm. Personal pools always use Persistent instead of this pooled setting.
Request Microsoft Intune enrollment for new Microsoft Entra joined session hosts. Requires tenant MDM auto-enrollment and appropriate licensing; use false for Personal host pools.
Daily VM shutdown time in 24-hour HH:mm format, Japan Standard Time. Default is 19:00.
